Members may only receive the points, vouchers, rewards and benefits during the Program Term and solely by the method established by CMX from time to time in its sole discretion.

Material changes, including price increases for the Rewards Plus plan or reductions in key benefits, will be notified to Members at least thirty (30) days in advance via email or a prominent notice on the CMX website. This includes modifications, cancellations, or terminations that affect a Member's ability to use the points, vouchers, rewards and benefits of the Program. Upon CMX Loyalty Program cancellation or termination, CMX will grant Members a thirty (30) day period (the "Final Redemption Period") to make use of any unredeemed Points, Vouchers, Rewards, or Benefits. No new Points, Vouchers, Rewards, or Benefits will be accrued or earned during this period; only the existing balances may be redeemed. Following the expiration of the Final Redemption Period, any remaining unredeemed points, vouchers, rewards, or benefits shall be automatically voided and eliminated without any liability or obligation to CMX.

Membership to CMX Loyalty Program is valid at participating CMX Theaters at all U.S. locations ("CMX Theaters"). Benefits, vouchers, points, or any rewards are not redeemable for cash under any circumstances, and cannot be used to purchase CMX gift cards. Abuse of CMX Loyalty Program may result in the cancellation of the Member's account.

To maintain account security and prevent fraudulent activity or duplicate memberships, each Member account must be associated with exactly one (1) unique and valid email address and one (1) unique and valid mobile phone number. The use of multiple identities, email addresses, or phone numbers to create duplicate accounts is strictly prohibited and may result in the immediate suspension or termination of all associated memberships and forfeiture of accrued benefits.

1. Enrollment

To join CMX Loyalty Program, customers must complete a sign-up by visiting CMX webpage (https://www.cmxcinemas.com) or downloading the mobile application and following the instructions provided. Members can choose between two options: a free Membership ("CMX Rewards Membership") or a Membership which offers paid benefits ("CMX Rewards PLUS"). A Member is any individual who has successfully completed the registration and enrollment process for the CMX Loyalty Program, in compliance with all terms set forth in this Agreement ("Member").

Members may request a physical Membership card at any participating CMX Theater location.

Membership in the CMX Rewards Program is strictly limited to individual natural persons who are at least eighteen (18) years of age or older and are legal residents of the United States. Minors under the age of 18 are not eligible to participate in the Program. By enrolling in the Program, you represent and warrant that you meet these age requirements and possess the legal capacity to agree to these Terms and Conditions. Accounts are individual (one account per person). Points, vouchers, benefits, rewards, and accounts cannot be transferred. Organizations, business entities, or any other groups are not allowed to register.

Members must provide a valid email address, name, date of birth, zip code and phone number. This information will be collected and stored according to CMX Digital Privacy Statement (https://www.cmxcinemas.com/privacy-statement) and CMX Terms of Use (https://www.cmxcinemas.com/terms-of-use). CMX is not responsible for any incorrect, incomplete or inaccurate information supplied or modified by the Member.

By enrolling Members agree to receive advertising, marketing materials, and other CMX Loyalty Program communications unless expressly disabling such features under each Member's profile preferences.

CMX reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to suspend or terminate any Member's account, and their ability to participate in CMX Loyalty Program, at any time. CMX may terminate an account without prior notice if it determines or suspects of fraudulent activity or material noncompliance with these terms. CMX may terminate an account for any other reason, provided it furnishes the Member with thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Automatic Payments. Payments are automatically charged on a recurring monthly basis to the payment method linked to your CMX account.

Initial Billing: Your first billing period starts on the day you enroll in the CMX Loyalty Program.

2.2. Recurring Cycle

Subsequent billing cycles will recur on the same calendar date each month. If your enrollment date doesn't exist in a given month (e.g., enrolling on the 31st), you will be billed on the final day of that month instead.

For every 100 points Members earn (which equals $100 spent), Members automatically receive a $5 reward voucher. These points are solely used to calculate voucher accrual and cannot be redeemed directly; only the generated reward vouchers may be used for purchases. Points will not be earned on the following purchases: alcohol, tax, gift cards, gratuities, purchases made with points, or any items bought an organization, or through third-party services (such as Fandango, Atom, or Groupon), or groups of eight (8) or more guests.

To earn points, Members must provide their Membership details at the time of purchase. This may be done by:

presenting their account number, physical card or digital mobile application card at the point of sale;
logging into their account on CMX website or mobile application for online purchases;
providing the phone number or email address associated with their account to a team Member at CMX Theatre.

Points are automatically tracked upon successful verification of the Member's ID. Points will be reflected in the Member's account within twenty-four (24) hours following the purchase.

The maximum amount eligible to earn points per day is $250 USD per account.

4. Redeeming Points

To redeem Vouchers, Members must identify their account at the point of sale as specified in Section 2. This is accomplished by providing account credentials at the point of sale or by logging into CMX website or mobile application. At the box office or concession stand, Members can pay using vouchers, credit, debit, gift cards, or cash, or a combination of these methods (subject to the limitations outlined for Movie Ticket Redemption). Vouchers cannot be used to purchase alcoholic beverages or gift cards.

Points and vouchers are not property and hold no cash value. Accumulated Points and vouchers are not descendible and cannot be inherited, bartered, purchased, transferred or sold to any third party.

Your Points balance and Vouchers balance will appear on each ticket purchased or in your online Member profile. The Points balance reflects the total points earned, which are solely used to accrue Vouchers. The Vouchers balance represents the rewards available for redemption towards tickets, food, and beverage purchases. Points and Vouchers have no cash value. Members are strictly prohibited from requesting a cash payment or "cash out" of any remaining balances, and this prohibition remains in effect even upon the termination or cancellation of any Membership tier.

Members can redeem vouchers for food and beverage items to apply toward regular-priced menu items. Vouchers cannot be combined with any other offers or discounts. (If a menu item costs $10 and a Member applies a $5 voucher, the Member will only need to pay the remaining $5 using cash or debit/credit card).

For the purpose of CMX Loyalty Program, "activity" is defined as any qualifying purchase, point accrual, or voucher redemption made by the Member.

The ticket is valid starting on the Member's birthday and expires sixty (60) days after that date. Members can redeem this ticket online via the CMX Application, the Website, or in-person at the box office. As a fraud prevention measure, the birthday ticket will not be issued if the date of birth entered matches the Member's account sign-up date.

6.2. Loyalty Wednesday Ticket Price

This weekly benefit allows active Members to purchase one (1) movie ticket at a special Member price every Wednesday at participating CMX theaters. Tickets must be purchased online or through the mobile app; the special price is not available at the box office. The offer cannot be combined with any other promotions, discounts, or vouchers. Standard surcharges for premium formats (e.g., IMAX, D-BOX, ATMOS, or Extreme) still apply and must be paid separately.

6.3. Promotional Multipliers

CMX may occasionally offer limited-time bonus points or promotional multipliers on qualifying purchases. These offers will be announced through official CMX channels and are subject to specific terms, conditions, and expiration dates.

7.1. Monthly Benefits

7.1.1. Eleven (11) Rewards points credited to the account.
7.1.2. Tickets Included: One (1) movie ticket is included in the Monthly Fee.
7.1.3. Companion Ticket: Members can purchase three (3) companion ticket at the same Member Fee on the same month. This benefit is available once per month.
7.4. Additional Purchase Option

In addition to the tickets above, Members have the option to purchase two (2) additional movie tickets each month at the discounted Member Fee each. This option is available regardless of whether the Companion Ticket benefit has been utilized.

7.5. Ticket Rollover

Allows the one (1) included monthly ticket to be carried over and remain available for use in the subsequent month if it is not redeemed during the current billing cycle. Unused tickets can be rolled over for a maximum of one (1) month.

Members receive 15% off on regular-priced food and beverage purchases. Excluding alcoholic beverages.

This benefit applies in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in Section 4.2. This benefit is valid exclusively for the purchase of movie tickets made either online or at the theatre box office, and may only be redeemed on Wednesdays for showtimes scheduled on Wednesdays.

Members PLUS-Only Giveaways and invitations to exclusive promotions and Member-only activities;
Eligibility to participate in gamified challenges and referral incentives.
